summary: Revert the mission projection source upgrade (#3554), which was never deployed

replay.detail: The reverted change was never released, so no running member has its projection definitions or its one-time repair; replay behaves as on the last deployed build.

schema.detail: No table, storage-version or claim-schema change; the local meta marker the reverted change would have written is not written.

rules.detail: No checkpoint retention rules, rules version, envelopes, seals or trim permission changes.

compatibility.detail: Mission-run, run-generation and step projection definition versions stay as in the last deployed build; no mixed-version behaviour changes.

downtime.detail: Removes a synchronous first-open walk of every terminal run, generation and carried step claim, so startup does not gain that work.

manual.detail: No manual step. Deploy through the normal reviewed rollout.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover: the reverted change never ran on a deployed member. The divergence it addressed is tracked separately.
